findings.evidence: "Pick a concern the counterpart would plausibly have about the user's goal" and "If only optional context is missing (audience seniority, deadline), state your assumption and proceed." Intake, Review and Roleplay occupy 38 of the 54 lines under the six main H2 sections and are predominantly activation of familiar coaching behavior, including output templates, rather than new expert knowledge. The strongest knowledge delta is concentrated in the specific uncertainty, accusation and escalation traps and the repository handoffs.
findings.fix: Preserve the scope routing, required-input fallback, output templates, completion conditions and concrete anti-patterns. Remove the routine optional-context reminder and compress Roleplay steps 1–3 to: "Raise one plausible in-character objection at a time. Privately test whether each reply resolves the concern while preserving the ask; choose the next scenario from that diagnosis, varying one feature." Keep generic coaching narration brief rather than expanding frameworks already supplied by the preloaded skills.
